versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "interactive-document-writing" skill.
- Enables collaborative, chapter-by-chapter creation and refinement of long-form documents (e.g. white papers, proposals, manuals, reports) via interactive Q&A.
- Features structured workflows: discovery, outline design, chapter loop, final review, and output, with persistent state tracking for interruption and resumption.
- Emphasizes one-question-at-a-time dialogue, visible progress, active engagement, and document audits.
- Includes robust handling of existing documents, user preferences, and long document performance.
